library.__note: THE FIRST SHADOW-DOM SUBJECT. Every component's CSS lives in shadowRoot.adoptedStyleSheets (Lit static styles) — document.styleSheets carries ZERO component rules — and every component's rendered box lives inside an open shadow root. See extract/computed/capture.ts SHADOW_HELPERS_JS for the two captured-root policies and examples/altitude/PROVENANCE.md for what each one was measured against.

mount.__note: LOAD-BEARING, THREE WAYS. (1) preScript sets globalThis.alAutoRegistry BEFORE the bundle evaluates — an `imports` line cannot, because ES import hoisting runs the library first, and WITHOUT the flag not one top-level tag registers (<al-button> stays an unknown element that renders its light children and nothing else). (2) headStyles puts style#al-theme-sheet in the document BEFORE the first connectedCallback — ALElement.getGlobalStyles() looks that id up ONCE, memoizes it on globalThis, adopts a stripped copy into every shadow root, and console.errors 'Altitude style#al-theme-sheet not found' otherwise; the tokens themselves are STRIPPED from that copy by the library and reach components by INHERITANCE from :root in the light DOM, so the same <style> is doing both jobs. (3) tokens-light.css is appended AFTER main.css because main.css's own :root block is the DARK set (322 names, dark values) — loading main.css alone gives a dark page under a light colorScheme. The Google-Fonts @import is stripped by the engine (quoted-string-aware; a naive [^;]+ strip cuts inside the URL's own semicolons and silently voids the whole :root token block — 323 custom properties to 0 with no error anywhere).

tokens.__note: varPrefix is --al-, NOT --al-theme-: the reader's tokenName() strips the prefix to get the DTCG leaf path, and Altitude carries BOTH tiers in one namespace (208 primitives + 115 semantic aliases). Prefixing at --al-theme- would leave every direct primitive reference unbindable. The recon's objection — that the ~40 UNDEFINED per-component escape hatches (--al-button-padding, --al-toggle-width) would crowd the candidates — is wrong and was measured: an undefined custom property computes to the empty string and the reader drops empty candidates before scoring them.

fonts.__note: FC-FONT-SUBSTRATE closure. NOT A GUESS: altitude-web-components/dist/css/main.css line 1 is @import"https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,400;1,600&display=swap" — the library's OWN declared faces, exactly these four (the harness strips that @import for network hermeticity; these committed files put the same family back, offline). Files committed under extract/computed/fonts/ from @ibm/plex-sans@1.1.0 (npm; also present in examples/carbon/.carbon-sandbox/node_modules/@ibm/plex-sans). Inlined as data: URIs — no network at render or check time; same files + same pinned Chromium => same rasters on the recording platform.

enumeration.__note: unsetLabel is "unset", not the drafter's "__unset" (underscores are outside the contract token-ref character class and fail ContractSchema.parse with errors that never mention the underscore — the Carbon lesson). It matters more here than anywhere: EVERY enum in this library is defaultless, so the pseudo-value is a segment of a minted token path on every single component.

components.__note: variant is DEFAULTLESS and there is NO 'primary' value — primary IS the unset axis value. The captured root is button.al-c-button inside the shadow root; the host <al-button> draws nothing (the library's purgecss build deletes its :host rule) and is recorded as the descent trail. `isDisabled` DROPPED: measured aria-disabled only, with bg/cursor/opacity identical to enabled.
components.name: Button

components.__note: isDot is a prop-selected RENDERING (a modifier class plus an ::after), so it is a VARIANT AXIS through $props, not a state and not a presence prop (it creates no subtree). `position` is not an axis at all — it mutates parentElement.style.
components.name: Badge

components.__note: href PINNED: the shadow template swaps its ROOT between <a> and <button> on this prop, so an unset href would make the anatomy a function of a non-axis. The value leaks into the root's classList verbatim (class="al-c-link #al") — a real library defect; classAllow drops it.
components.name: Link

components.__note: THE DEPTH-2 CASE. hasBadge mounts a nested <al-badge> — a custom element with its OWN shadow root — inside the avatar's shadow tree. The reader keeps the nested HOST as an element (it occupies a real box in its parent's layout and is the inheritance link its inner box reads) and descends into ITS shadow root for children; only the CAPTURED ROOT descends past a host.
components.name: Avatar

components.__note: blockStage: a heading is a display:block element and shrink-to-fits inside the flex stage. tagName is held at its default h2 and is NOT an axis (semantic, and it shadows Element.prototype.tagName).
components.name: Heading

components.__note: blockStage is REQUIRED, not cosmetic: measured 0x1px in the default flex stage (an <hr> is a shrink-to-fit flex item) and 288x1px in a block formatting context. The vertical variant then measures 1x64px in the same stage.
components.name: Divider

components.__note: The svg-promotion path reached through the shadow reader: the glyph is an inline <svg> inside al-icon-close's shadow root. size is defaultless (unset renders 16px) and is the widest axis in the round at 8 values.
components.name: IconClose
